question: Consider $A=\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & a \\ 0 & 1 & b \\ a & b & 1 \end{bmatrix}$. For which value(s) of $a$ and $b$ is $A$ skew symmetric?
explanation:
A skew symmetric matrix satisfies $A' = -A$.
Compare $A$ and $A'$:
$A_{13}=a$, $A_{31}=a$, so $a = -a \implies a = 0$.
$A_{23}=b$, $A_{32}=b$, so $b = -b \implies b = 0$.
$A_{11} = 1 = -1 \implies$ Not possible.
So, no values possible.
Answer: (C) No values.
